object.attr: stakeholder: an object ID names one object for good, because links on other branches, history, Compare and issued PDFs refer to it. Fixing ID reuse was decided on 2026-11-06 (open question Q7). Either side may have used numbers the other hasn't seen.
object.description: When Mellon resolves a merge, Mellon shall set each merged document's next object number to the highest of both sides' numbers and one more than the merged document's highest object number.
